name: Chat app
prompt: I want a real-time team chat app with channels, direct messages, user online status, and markdown message formatting for remote engineering squads.

name: Banking app
prompt: Build a modern personal banking dashboard where customers can view checking and savings balances, transfer money between accounts, view transaction history, and freeze debit cards.

name: Recipe box
prompt: A recipe box app where home cooks can save culinary recipes with ingredients and step-by-step instructions, organize by category, and generate consolidated shopping lists.

name: Portfolio
prompt: A sleek portfolio website for a senior product designer featuring interactive case studies, design philosophy, client testimonials, downloadable resume, and a contact form.

name: Habit tracker
prompt: A daily habit tracker application with streak tracking, completion checklists, weekly progress analytics, habit categories, and reminder notifications.

name: Marketplace
prompt: A peer-to-peer marketplace for buying and selling used musical instruments, featuring product listings with photos and condition filters, seller ratings, and direct messaging.

name: Booking
prompt: An online appointment booking system for a boutique hair salon allowing clients to select stylists, view available time slots, book services, and manage appointments.

name: Agency PM tool
prompt: A project management tool tailored for digital agencies to track client deliverables, assign tasks to designers and developers, log billable hours, and monitor project budgets.
